use default

class NODE[T](value: T) is
    next: NODE[T]?

    insert_after(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.next = next
        next = inserted

        inserted
    si
si

values[T](first: NODE[T]) -> Pipe[T] is
    let cursor: NODE[T]? mut = first

    while let node = cursor do
        yield node.value
        cursor = node.next
    od
